correctness.rationale: Szpond's published free resolution gives a three-dimensional Cohen--Macaulay homogeneous coordinate ring, while the published singular locus consists of exactly three points, so Serre \(S_2+R_1\) gives normality. The contraction resolves each point by one smooth rational \((-3)\)-curve, hence the Hirzebruch--Jung classification identifies the local analytic type as \(\frac13(1,1)\). Adjunction gives discrepancy \(-1/3\), and the quotient character gives canonical index three and local class group \(\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z\). Using \(f^*K_X=K_Y+\frac13\sum N_i\), the exact intersection arithmetic gives \(K_X^2=1\), \(K_X\cdot\mathcal O_X(1)=-3\), and sectional genus three. The package verifier checks all intersection and quotient-index arithmetic exactly.
residual_risks: The result is specific to the named \(B_3\) surface over \(\mathbb C\).
